extracted.intended_audience: Worldcon members, Hugo voters, nominees, authors, publishers and fans following the 2025 Hugo Awards
extracted.subtask_description: Record of 2025 Hugo Awards finalists, ballots and a number of procedural/eligibility notes for the awards presented at Seattle Worldcon 2025. Contains explicit administrative rules (e.g., administrator ineligibility, word-count requirement for Best Series), ballot deadlines, and reporting practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nominating ballot deadline & electorate
rubrics_metrics.description: "1,338 valid electronic nominating ballots were received by the deadline of March 14 at 11:59 p.m. PDT and counted from the members of the 2024 and 2025 World Science Fiction Conventions for the 2025 Hugo Awards. Unfortunately, two mailed ballots were received 2.5 weeks later on April 3 after the deadline of receipt. (The initial publication of the finalists had an error of 1,738 ballots instead of the correct number of 1,338.)"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominating ballots must be received by the published deadline to be valid; only ballots from members of the specified Worldcons (2024 and 2025) were counted. Late mailed ballots received after the deadline are not counted; errors in published counts may be corrected and noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final ballot counting/reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: "1962 final ballots were counted over all 21 categories, including this year’s special category for best poem."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Final ballots are counted and reported across all categories; the page records the total number of final ballots counted for transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category-level public statistics (ballots/nominees/finalist vote ranges)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each award category the page reports counts such as ballots cast, number of nominees, and the range of nominating votes among finalists (for example: "1078 ballots cast for 554 nominees, finalists range 90 to 157").
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Awards publish per-category statistics (ballots cast, nominees, and finalist vote ranges) as part of results reporting to provide transparency about the nominating and final-ballot process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Series minimum total-word requirement (eligibility)
rubrics_metrics.description: "Best Series: The Singing Hills Cycle, by Nghi Vo (fewer than 240,000 words in total)" (listed as having received enough votes to qualify but found to be ineligible).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A series submitted for Best Series must meet the stated minimum total-word requirement (here, 240,000 words); failing that threshold renders a work ineligible even if it receives sufficient nominating votes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dramatic Presentation (Short Form) eligibility: first-performance/publication year
rubrics_metrics.description: Example ineligibility: "Best Dramatic Presentation, Short Form: Dune, the Musical (first performed in 2023)" — listed as having received enough votes to qualify but found to be ineligible.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dramatic Presentation entries must meet the Awards' eligibility window for first performance/publication; works first performed in prior years (outside the eligibility period) are ineligible even if they receive sufficient votes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-nomination eligibility review and removal
rubrics_metrics.description: "The following nominees received enough votes to qualify for the final ballot, but were found to be ineligible:" followed by examples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Qualifying by vote does not guarantee placement on the final ballot; an eligibility review can remove nominees after they have initially qualified. Organizers perform checks and will exclude works that fail to meet eligibility criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nominee withdrawal or declination
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples given: "Yooh Ha Lee withdrew Moonstorm from consideration after the finalists were announced." and "The following nominees ... declined nomination: Lodestar Award: Compound Fracture by Andrew Joseph White (Peachtree Teen)"
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Nominees or their representatives may withdraw or decline a nomination after the finalists are announced; the Awards record such withdrawals/declinations in the official results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrator ineligibility to be nominated
rubrics_metrics.description: "Resigned as administrators on May 5, 2025, but remain listed here as persons ineligible for the 2025 Hugo Awards, because anyone who was a member of the Hugo Awards Administration Subcommittee for that Worldcon remains ineligible for the duration of that year’s Awards."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Anyone who served on the Hugo Awards Administration Subcommittee for that Worldcon is ineligible to be nominated for that year's Awards (they remain listed as ineligible even if they resign).

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication of special categories and sponsorship notes
rubrics_metrics.description: Page notes items such as "including this year’s special category for best poem" and labels like "Astounding Award for Best New Writer (sponsored by Dell Magazines)".
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Awards may include special categories in a given year and will note sponsorships; such annotations affect how categories are presented and understood but may also carry their own eligibility or sponsorship-related rules (not fully enumerated on this page).
